children: Andrew C. Sagliocca, a director and Vice Chairman, President & CEO, reported a sale of common stock on September 18, 2026. The filing lists a weighted average selling price of $122.73 per share. The total reported sale amount was $1,227,300. After the transaction, Sagliocca directly owned 288,798 shares of common stock. The filing states the shares were sold in multiple transactions at prices ranging from $122.61 to $123.50 and that the reporting person will provide further breakdowns upon request.
